mapper.sql:
where e.del_flag = 0
and (e.emp_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or e.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or e.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or e.email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and (e.dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(cast(#{deptId} as char), d.ancestors))
and e.status = #{status}
mapper.select:
select e.id, e.emp_no, e.name, e.gender, e.phone, e.email, e.avatar, e.dept_id, d.dept_name, e.job_title, e.hire_date, e.status, e.remark, e.create_time, e.update_time, e.last_login_time, e.last_login_ip, e.pwd_update_time from sys_employee e left join sys_dept d on d.id = e.dept_id
order by e.id limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from sys_employee e left join sys_dept d on d.id = e.dept_id
select * from sys_employee where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0
select * from sys_employee where emp_no = #{empNo} and del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: insert into sys_employee (emp_no, password, name, gender, phone, email, avatar, dept_id, job_title, hire_date, status, remark, create_by, update_by, pwd_update_time) values (#{empNo}, #{password}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{deptId}, #{jobTitle}, #{hireDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update sys_employee set del_flag = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update sys_employee set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update sys_employee set password = #{password}, pwd_update_time = #{pwdUpdateTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select distinct p.perm_code from sys_employee_role er join sys_role_permission rp on rp.role_id = er.role_id join sys_permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id and p.status = 1 where er.employee_id = #{employeeId}
